In away I do understand you explanation but as a consumer this is not what you expected or what you was looking after. Maybe I was lucky that the purchase didn’t succeed because I think Spark 2 is much more for the money however I have not get my purchase yet so let’s see. It’s on the way.

I’m very happy and satisfied with Spark NEO and that was the only reason for this new purchase of Spark 2. A discount of 5% is a nice gesture yes but could easily be 15-20% to keep a member satisfied and for a good reputation. However I think cases like mine is less than one in a thousand. Just let you know.

Usually I don’t bother to get feedback as every company and every purchase now a days follows a feedback request. I do it because I think you have the right attitude and will and that your products seem good and innovative :)

Regads
Kaj

I waited a significantly longer time than I would have thought to have had to wait just for an AI response. That's... dirty butt cheeks, dude.

After asking for an actual human, all I got was legitimately just a person reciting an AI overview. None of my concerns were actually addressed and I wrote an extremely lengthy and detailed feature request that included the desire to be in the loop and maybe even speak to accountable parties like engineers, devs ect. as I am myself a software dev.
All I want is a looper that actually functions like any other looper. Give me numerator and denominator control, bro. Keep it separate from your stupid groove looper that is jank as hell. Boom, you don't even have to worry about training your AI on different time signatures anymore.
I was asked to create a new account under a new email, michaeljhanson80@gmail.com so that my existing account could be migrated.  It didn’t happen on your end.  Old account mhanson14@tx.rr.com

It was frustrating to be unable to interact with a human being for 2+ days.  You should have a customer service phone number.  If you refuse to do that, then your chat or email function should connect me to a human being.  The problem arose unpredictably and then went away, all without any real explanation.  It became clear that the problem was connectivity on your end, not mine, so that other users must have experienced the same thing.  At the very least, you could have sent an email auto-response acknowledging that you were having a known problem and were working on it, and expected service to be restored within __ number of hours or days.

All I was asking for was an estimated shipping cost to Hawaii for a Spark 2. I just got the runaround, with the response that it would be determined at checkout. I want to know the cost before checking out. Have you never shipped a Spark 2 to Hawaii? You’d think I was asking the impossible. Not a good start to a customer service experience. The result made me think twice and pause my order with the company.
Had to change my e-mail to acces my product,not at all ok

I had a message thread going about the challenges I was facing, but the customer service representative only replied once. 

IMPORTANT:

I CURRENTLY HAVE TWO DIFFERENT EMAILS FOR ACCOUNTS IN YOUR SYSTEM. 

zurv33z@gmail.com IS THE ONE I WANT TO KEEP. 

INITIALLY I WAS GOING TO HAVE THE SERVICE REP SWITCH MY JIMI HENDRIX SOFTWARE OVER TO sbalger@hotmail.com.

... BUT THAT LOGIN STOPPED RECOGNIZING THE AMP FOR SOME REASON. 

MY ONLY CONCERN NOW IS TO SWITCH MY REGISTRATION FOR WARRANTY AND OTHER STUFF OVER TO zurv33z@gmail.com.

PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU DO NOT SWITCH MY SOFTWARE BACK OVER TO THE FIRST EMAIL! 

TY

-sb alger
Give us paid effects like auto-wah for the Spark 2 and Spark mini.. that would benefit everyone.

I ordered a Spark amp, it took way too long to ship, and when it arrived the power supply cord was missing. I received an automated response email, and it took two weeks to finally receive all of the parts that were missing from my original shipment. 

I expect better service.

The recent email about new patches available from Steve Vai – Fire aren't showing up in Tone Cloud Artist list. I figure that PG would've done the upload prior to broadcasting the tones availability to its customers.
Overall the support was good, but the whole process was just draining and inefficient. Texting for 6 Days just to not get a real span of possible solutions is just annoying.

The reasons above dont really fit my scenario, but the support automation process failed at some point and did not pick up my emails to attach to my ticket.  I tried a couple times and eventually some messaging went through after my ticket was closed for non-response.  I could not update my ticket from the web portal, only via email response.  

Your AI also told me not to do something with the grille initially that I later found out was standard. (Removing the grille)   

I still dont have a solution technically, other than removing the grille completely.  I had asked for some information about the grille so I could try and design one in CAD that I could 3D print.  I think if the vents are allowed to pass air more easily through the grille it will remove the rattle/vibration.

Anyways please dont take this as negative product feedback (I love this thing!)  I was just hoping to find a solution to the vibrations.

The support team does a good job as far as I'm concerned. But your system's automated messages need to be tuned down. The reminders for requestors to respond are too frequent and aggressive. And if your platform allows it, consider randomizing the CSAT scores so not every ticket generates a survey. 

Love you guys. 

-Derek, 20 years in IT management

I was sent a defective item. I was asked to return. I sent pictures and video of issue and serial #s. Support sent label and asked to return. Label had wrong name and i tried to flag. Support said i was wrong and to send. In confusion i sent item. They then shipped replacement item to wrong address. I reached out to support and i was told i was wrong again, and my fault and asked to contact the person the item was sent to in order to retrieve my item i paid for.

I was sent a defective item. I was asked to return. I sent pictures and video of issue and serial #s. Support sent label and asked to return. Label had wrong name and i tried to flag. Support said i was wrong and to send. In confusion i sent item. They then shipped replacement item to wrong address. I reached out to support and i was told i was wrong again, and my fault. Multiple screenshots and emails later it was realized support read the serial # wrong. I was then asked to contact the person the item was sent to in order to retrieve my item i paid for. After complaining I was told it was their fault and a replacement being sent anf given a 5 percent discount off next purchase which is laughable and an insult after the waste of time i experience trying to receive a working product i paid for. I STILL DO NOT HAVE PRODUCT WEEKS LATER

The replacement unit I received and paid for does not work and has the same battery issue as the unit I sent back. This is a colossal waste of time for me. I am spending my days testing equipment and responding to technical support emails when I could be making $560/hr. at my job as a lawyer. It is ridiculous that you would not test the replacement unit before sending it to me. I am very disappointed with your service.

I have several PG products and v happy. But my brand new frfr CAB hums too loudly. Customer support not helpful. Suggest that some noise is normal, and that my house wiring may be causing it. (My other equipment is fine) I tried to return cab to Amazon but postage label requires me to pay shipping. I have had a week of emails to of and now Amazon. Not what I thought I was buying. All goodwill is gone.

I expect the control X and Spark Live to work seamlessly. I was using that combination to gig for some time.  Suddenly at one of the gigs, the Bluetooth connection between the two failed.  I asked PG support what to do and it was suggested that I use the little pinhole in the control X to reset it.  I did that, the Live and control X worked at a couple more gigs and then failed again.  I ask PG support what now? The answer was to save my presets and factory reset the Live.  Sounds to me like PG support doesn’t know the root problem and is just sending me on “try this” errands hoping  one of them will fix the problem.  I’ve lost faith in PG products and have gone back to my Fender Deluxe Reverb.
Too much AI, no phone number, delay in AI generated responses. I just want help from a live person over the phone to fix the connection issue

Passed from. One AI bot to another
 Very frustrating PLUS 2 days between each exchange of emails
